course_info.trial_description:
Objectives: 
-To evaluate and determine a student’s English level.
                                        -To determine the starting point of our first lesson.
What to expect: 
-I would ask that your child bring a favorite toy, book or item to class.  Something we may look at together, and I can use to determine your child’s understanding.
-With the use of props, I will determine your child’s understanding of simple questions, such as “Hello, how are you?”  “What did you do today?”
-If there is no understanding, I will use props and pictures, to have your child attempt to communicate with me.
Please do not become upset with your child if they are reluctant.  It is my job to make them feel comfortable and willing to communicate with me.  If they do not, perhaps I am not the right teacher for them. Although, I have had students who do not speak a great deal, for a few lessons, but they listen, and they enjoy watching me work hard.  It is up to you, as the parent, to decide if I am a good fit.
Teaching is one of my greatest joys, only surpassed by being a mother and grandmother.  Children generally respond extremely well to me, and I have built wonderful relationships with many of my students.  I offer a safe environment full of laughter and learning.  It is my belief that we all learn better when we can enjoy, explore and laugh our way through learning.

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Speaking Exam Preparation
pro_course_detail.description:
This course will prepare students for the IELTS speaking exam. I will cover all 3 parts of the speaking exam using the official topics used in the actual IELTS examination. I will teach you useful idioms, sentence starters and provide model answers for the official topics. Additionally, we will focus on the 4 IELTS assessment criteria and work on getting you the IELTS band you deserve! My focus will be on improving: 

•	fluency and flow of speech
•	pronunciation and word stress 
•	appropriate use of vocabulary, phrasal verbs and paraphrasing
•	grammar structures and complex sentences

We will also do timed practice of all parts of the exam to best prepare you. I will provide you with feedback and corrections throughout our lessons. If you have any questions, feel free to contact me.

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Writing Editing and Feedback Service (OFFLINE)
pro_course_detail.description:
In these lessons I will edit your writing for task 1 and 2 of the IELTS writing exam. I will provide you with corrections, improvements and feedback. In my feedback, I will give you an explanation of how you can improve your score for the IELTS writing exam so that you can achieve the IELTS band you want.

These lessons are done OFFLINE. We do not meet for a 1 on 1 lesson. You will send me your writing and I will do the editing offline. I will complete the editing within 72 hours of you sending me your writing. I will give you instructions on how to send me your writing once you have booked a lesson.

You can book a 60 minute lesson or a 30 minute lesson.

A 60 minute lesson:
Two task 1 writing tasks
OR
One task 1 and one task 2 essay
OR
Two task 2 essays

A 30 minute lesson:
One task 1 writing task
OR
One task 2 essay

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Writing Preparation (ONLINE)
pro_course_detail.description:
These lessons will guide students through IELTS writing. We will learn about strategies for answering IELTS writing questions for task 1 and the task 2 essay. I will provide feedback on your completed IELTS writing questions. I can send you IELTS writing questions to complete before our class.

All feedback will be based on the marking criteria. This includes:

•	the structure and style of task 1 and task 2 writing
•	answering the question and choosing the right information to analyse
•	appropriate use of vocabulary, linking words paraphrasing
•	grammatical structures and writing information logically

These lessons are online lessons. Google Docs will be used during class for writing exercises.
